tei:div.tei:p: Lord of the universe, thou didst command us through Moses thy servant concerning the counting of the Omer, in order to cleanse us of our evil things and impurities; thou didst write in thy Torah: “You shall count from the day following the day of rest, from the day you brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven full weeks shall be counted; you shall count fifty days to the day following the seventh week.” May all thy people of Israel be purged from their impurities. May it be thy will, Lord our God and God of our fathers, that my counting the Omer today help set right again the errors I have committed; may I rise high in purity and holiness. Amen.
